## How many gadgets do you own?

```{=html}
<!--
  Gadget count survey with a Poisson fit.
  Enter how many people own 0, 1, 2, ... gadgets (type a number or use - / +).
  The bars update straight away, lambda is estimated by the sample mean
  (the maximum likelihood estimate), and "Show Poisson fit" overlays the
  fitted counts n * P(K = k).

  Settings (on the .pz div below):
    data-max-k   largest gadget count shown (default 10). People with more
                 can be entered in the last column; they are counted at that value.
-->
<div class="pz" data-max-k="10">
  <div class="pz-main">
    <div class="pz-chart" data-out="chart"></div>
    <div class="pz-side">
      <div class="pz-stat"><div class="pz-num" data-out="n">0</div><div class="pz-lab">People</div></div>
      <div class="pz-stat"><div class="pz-num" data-out="sum">0</div><div class="pz-lab">Gadgets in total</div></div>
      <div class="pz-stat pz-key">
        <div class="pz-num"><span class="pz-lambda">λ̂ =</span> <span data-out="lam">–</span></div>
        <div class="pz-lab">Gadgets ÷ people</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pz-var">Variance <span data-out="var">–</span><br><span class="pz-note">A Poisson model expects this to be close to λ̂</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pz-tools">
    <button type="button" class="pz-btn" data-act="fit">Show Poisson fit</button>
    <span class="pz-legend"><i class="pz-key-bar"></i>Class data <i class="pz-key-fit"></i>Poisson fit</span>
    <span class="pz-spacer"></span>
    <button type="button" class="pz-small" data-act="reset">Reset</button>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
.reveal .pz {
  --pz-accent: #24476b;
  --pz-mark: #a8322a;
  --pz-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  --pz-line: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent);
  text-align: left;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  margin-top: 0.2em;
}
.reveal .pz .pz-main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 230px; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }

.reveal .pz .pz-chart { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
.reveal .pz .pz-plot { position: relative; height: 290px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--pz-line); }
.reveal .pz .pz-bar {
  position: absolute; left: 12%; right: 12%; bottom: 0; height: 0;
  background: var(--pz-accent); border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0;
  transition: height 0.25s ease;
}
.reveal .pz .pz-val {
  position: absolute; bottom: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-size: 0.45em; font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 3px; white-space: nowrap;
}
.reveal .pz .pz-fit {
  display: none; position: absolute; left: 2%; right: 2%; height: 0;
  border-top: 3px dashed var(--pz-mark); transition: bottom 0.25s ease;
}
.reveal .pz .pz-fit::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -7.5px; width: 12px; height: 12px;
  margin-left: -6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pz-mark);
}
.reveal .pz.show-fit .pz-fit { display: block; }
.reveal .pz .pz-k { text-align: center; font-size: 0.55em; font-weight: 700; margin: 6px 0 4px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-exp {
  visibility: hidden; text-align: center; font-size: 0.36em; color: var(--pz-mark);
  font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.3em;
}
.reveal .pz.show-fit .pz-exp { visibility: visible; }
.reveal .pz .pz-in {
  width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font: inherit; font-size: 0.5em; text-align: center;
  padding: 0.2em 0; border: 1.5px solid var(--pz-line); border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent; color: inherit; -moz-appearance: textfield;
}
.reveal .pz .pz-in::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
.reveal .pz .pz-in::-webkit-inner-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; }
.reveal .pz .pz-step { display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-top: 4px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-step button {
  flex: 1; font: inherit; font-size: 0.5em; line-height: 1.2; padding: 0.1em 0;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--pz-line); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent;
  color: inherit; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .pz .pz-step button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); }

.reveal .pz .pz-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-stat { border-top: 3px solid var(--pz-line); padding-top: 6px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-key { border-top-color: var(--pz-accent); }
.reveal .pz .pz-num { font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; }
.reveal .pz .pz-key .pz-num { color: var(--pz-accent); font-size: 1.3em; }
.reveal .pz .pz-lambda { font-size: 0.7em; font-weight: 400; }
.reveal .pz .pz-lab { font-size: 0.45em; opacity: 0.75; margin-top: 3px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-var { font-size: 0.5em; }
.reveal .pz .pz-var span[data-out] { font-weight: 700; }
.reveal .pz .pz-note { font-size: 0.8em; opacity: 0.7; }

.reveal .pz .pz-tools { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; margin-top: 14px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-spacer { flex: 1; }
.reveal .pz .pz-btn {
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.5em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--pz-mark);
  padding: 0.4em 1em; border: 2.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .pz .pz-legend { font-size: 0.42em; opacity: 0.8; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-legend i { display: inline-block; width: 16px; height: 12px; margin-left: 10px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-key-bar { background: var(--pz-accent); border-radius: 2px; }
.reveal .pz .pz-key-fit { height: 0 !important; border-top: 3px dashed var(--pz-mark); }
.reveal .pz .pz-small {
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.42em; padding: 0.35em 0.9em; color: inherit;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--pz-line); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .pz button:focus-visible, .reveal .pz .pz-in:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pz-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal .pz .pz-bar, .reveal .pz .pz-fit { transition: none; }
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  function poissonPmf(k, lam) {
    // e^-lam * lam^k / k!, computed in log space to stay stable
    var logp = -lam + (k ? k * Math.log(lam) : 0);
    for (var i = 2; i <= k; i++) logp -= Math.log(i);
    return Math.exp(logp);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.pz:not([data-ready])').forEach(function (root) {
    root.dataset.ready = '1';
    var maxK = Number(root.dataset.maxK) || 10;
    var chart = root.querySelector('[data-out="chart"]');
    var out = function (name) { return root.querySelector('[data-out="' + name + '"]'); };
    var counts = [];
    var cols = [];

    for (var k = 0; k <= maxK; k++) {
      counts.push(0);
      var col = document.createElement('div');
      col.className = 'pz-col';
      col.innerHTML =
        '<div class="pz-plot"><div class="pz-bar"><span class="pz-val"></span></div><div class="pz-fit"></div></div>' +
        '<div class="pz-k">' + k + '</div>' +
        '<div class="pz-exp"></div>' +
        '<input class="pz-in" type="number" min="0" step="1" inputmode="numeric" value="0" aria-label="People with ' + k + ' gadgets">' +
        '<div class="pz-step"><button type="button" data-d="-1" aria-label="One fewer">−</button><button type="button" data-d="1" aria-label="One more">+</button></div>';
      col.dataset.k = k;
      chart.appendChild(col);
      cols.push({
        bar: col.querySelector('.pz-bar'),
        val: col.querySelector('.pz-val'),
        fit: col.querySelector('.pz-fit'),
        exp: col.querySelector('.pz-exp'),
        input: col.querySelector('.pz-in')
      });
    }

    function render() {
      var n = 0, sum = 0;
      counts.forEach(function (c, k) { n += c; sum += k * c; });
      var lam = n ? sum / n : 0;
      var variance = 0;
      if (n > 1) {
        counts.forEach(function (c, k) { variance += c * (k - lam) * (k - lam); });
        variance /= n - 1;
      }
      var fitted = counts.map(function (c, k) { return n && lam > 0 ? n * poissonPmf(k, lam) : 0; });
      var showFit = root.classList.contains('show-fit');
      var ymax = Math.max.apply(null, counts.concat(showFit ? fitted : [], [1])) * 1.15;

      cols.forEach(function (col, k) {
        col.bar.style.height = (100 * counts[k]) / ymax + '%';
        col.val.textContent = counts[k] ? counts[k] : '';
        col.fit.style.bottom = (100 * fitted[k]) / ymax + '%';
        col.exp.textContent = n ? fitted[k].toFixed(1) : '';
        if (document.activeElement !== col.input) col.input.value = counts[k];
      });

      out('n').textContent = n;
      out('sum').textContent = sum;
      out('lam').textContent = n ? lam.toFixed(2) : '–';
      out('var').textContent = n > 1 ? variance.toFixed(2) : '–';
    }

    chart.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest('button[data-d]');
      if (!b) return;
      var k = Number(b.closest('.pz-col').dataset.k);
      counts[k] = Math.max(0, counts[k] + Number(b.dataset.d));
      b.blur(); // keep reveal.js arrow-key navigation working
      render();
    });

    chart.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      if (!e.target.classList.contains('pz-in')) return;
      var k = Number(e.target.closest('.pz-col').dataset.k);
      var v = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
      counts[k] = isNaN(v) || v < 0 ? 0 : v;
      render();
    });

    // Typing in a box shouldn't trigger reveal.js shortcuts; Enter finishes the entry
    chart.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (!e.target.classList.contains('pz-in')) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Escape') e.target.blur();
    });
    chart.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
      if (e.target.classList.contains('pz-in')) render();
    });

    root.querySelector('.pz-tools').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest('button[data-act]');
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.dataset.act === 'fit') {
        var on = root.classList.toggle('show-fit');
        b.textContent = on ? 'Hide Poisson fit' : 'Show Poisson fit';
      } else if (b.dataset.act === 'reset') {
        if (counts.some(Boolean) && !window.confirm('Clear all the gadget counts?')) return;
        counts = counts.map(function () { return 0; });
      }
      b.blur();
      render();
    });

    render();
  });
})();
</script>
```
